verses.zh: 众子啊，要听父亲的教训，留心得知聪明。
verses.kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.en: Children, listen to a father's teaching, and pay attention so you can understand.

verses.zh: 因我所给你们的是好教训；不可离弃我的法则。
verses.kjv: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.en: What I am giving you is good teaching; do not turn away from it.

verses.zh: 我在父亲面前为孝子，在母亲眼中为独一的娇儿。
verses.kjv: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.en: I too was a son to my father, and in my mother's eyes her only precious boy.

verses.zh: 父亲教训我说：你心要存记我的言语，遵守我的命令，便得存活。
verses.kjv: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.en: He taught me and said: hold my words in your heart; keep my commands and you will live.

verses.zh: 要得智慧，要得聪明，不可忘记，也不可偏离我口中的言语。
verses.kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.en: Get wisdom, get understanding. Do not forget, and do not turn away from what I say.

verses.zh: 不可离弃智慧，智慧就护卫你；要爱她，她就保守你。
verses.kjv: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.en: Do not leave wisdom behind, and she will protect you; love her, and she will keep you safe.

verses.zh: 智慧为首；所以，要得智慧。在你一切所得之内必得聪明。
verses.kjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.en: Wisdom is the most important thing, so get wisdom. Whatever else you get, get understanding.

verses.zh: 高举智慧，她就使你高升；怀抱智慧，她就使你尊荣。
verses.kjv: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.en: Treasure her, and she will lift you up; hold her close, and she will bring you honour.

verses.zh: 她必将华冠加在你头上，把荣冕交给你。
verses.kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
verses.en: She will put a beautiful crown on your head and hand you a crown of glory.

verses.zh: 我儿，你要听受我的言语，就必延年益寿。
verses.kjv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.en: My son, listen and take in what I say, and the years of your life will be many.

verses.zh: 我已指教你走智慧的道，引导你行正直的路。
verses.kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
verses.en: I have taught you the way of wisdom and led you along straight paths.

verses.zh: 你行走，脚步必不致狭窄；你奔跑，也不致跌倒。
verses.kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.en: When you walk, your steps will not be blocked; when you run, you will not trip.

verses.zh: 要持定训诲，不可放松；必当谨守，因为它是你的生命。
verses.kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
verses.en: Hold tight to what you have been taught. Do not let go — it is your life.

verses.zh: 不可行恶人的路；不要走坏人的道。
verses.kjv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
verses.en: Do not go down the road of bad people, or walk the way of those who do wrong.

verses.zh: 要躲避，不可经过；要转身而去。
verses.kjv: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.en: Stay away from it, do not pass by it; turn around and go.

verses.zh: 这等人若不行恶，不得睡觉；不使人跌倒，睡卧不安；
verses.kjv: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.en: Those people cannot sleep unless they have done something wrong; they lie awake unless they have made someone fall.

verses.zh: 因为他们以奸恶吃饼，以强暴喝酒。
verses.kjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.en: Doing wrong is like bread to them, and being cruel is like wine.

verses.zh: 但义人的路好像黎明的光，越照越明，直到日午。
verses.kjv: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.en: But the path of people who do right is like the morning light, getting brighter and brighter until noon.

verses.zh: 恶人的道好像幽暗，自己不知因什么跌倒。
verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.en: The way of bad people is like the dark; they do not even know what they tripped over.

verses.zh: 我儿，要留心听我的言词，侧耳听我的话语，
verses.kjv: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.en: My son, pay attention to what I say; listen carefully to my words.

verses.zh: 都不可离你的眼目，要存记在你心中。
verses.kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.en: Do not let them out of your sight; keep them deep in your heart,

verses.zh: 因为得着它的，就得了生命，又得了医全体的良药。
verses.kjv: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.en: because they are life to whoever finds them, and healing for the whole body.

verses.zh: 你要保守你心，胜过保守一切，因为一生的果效是由心发出。
verses.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.en: Guard your heart more than anything else, because everything you do flows out of it.

verses.zh: 你要除掉邪僻的口，弃绝乖谬的嘴。
verses.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.en: Get rid of crooked talk; keep twisted words far away from you.

verses.zh: 你的眼目要向前正看；你的眼睛当向前直观。
verses.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.en: Let your eyes look straight ahead; keep your gaze fixed in front of you.

verses.zh: 要修平你脚下的路，坚定你一切的道。
verses.kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
verses.en: Think carefully about the path your feet are on, and all your ways will be steady.

verses.zh: 不可偏向左右；要使你的脚离开邪恶。
verses.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.en: Do not turn off to the right or the left; keep your foot away from what is wrong.
